criteria.AC-01: pass: six fresh real Terraform/strict SSH/Ansible lifecycles, each with frozen same-run evidence and exact cleanup; healthy path passed all ten required checks
criteria.AC-02: pass: bounded module command and fixed prerequisite images/tools/storage/identity requirements documented in docs/VALIDATION.md and current checkpoint; immutable tested source retained
criteria.AC-03: pass: container-only reference, original baked smoke payload, unfinished candidate/full pipeline and production ISO ineligibility remain explicit
criteria.AC-04: pass: actual dpkg package versions, OS, SSH configuration SHA, smoke payload SHA and pure public-key function observations collected through real SSH Ansible; readable and JSON rows agree
criteria.AC-05: pass: fresh controlled version/function expectations, actual configured missing interpreter, actual Ansible check-mode skip and actual stopped-target unreachable remain failed; require_passed rejects every negative
criteria.AC-06: pass: ten checks frozen before validation, original raw captures replayed, read-only collection, no repair/reuse; six distinct run/attempt identities and primary failures retained through cleanup

review.kind: independent engineering subagent source review; not independent human examination

limits: Version/function faults deliberately change expected comparisons; they do not claim a defective function or package removal.
The interpreter case configures an absent path; installed Python packages are not removed.
The smoke payload is the original qualified baked runtime; candidate-derived image binding remains WORM-013.
Raw captures, Terraform state and keys remain private. Run-file measurements are logical samples, not reserved storage or continuous peaks.
Cleanup success does not change the failed underlying negative operation. No full pipeline, VM/ISO/STIG, scanner compatibility or Lightspeed repair is established.
